BcfClaim declared in modular fragment (ADR-037 — never edit shillinq_register.json monolith) with all REQ-BCF-002 fields: claimQuarter (string), administrationId (string), totalCompensableAmount (number, derived), breakdown (array, derived), state (enum draft/submitted/accepted/settled), submittedOn/acceptedOn/settledOn (datetime, nullable), settledAmount (number, nullable), attachmentUri (string, nullable), notes (string, nullable). Required: claimQuarter + administrationId + state.

x-openregister-lifecycle declared on BcfClaim: field=state, initialState=draft, states draft/submitted/accepted/settled with Dutch labels (Concept/Ingediend/Geaccepteerd/Afgewikkeld); transitions submit (draft→submitted, requires OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\BcfClaimGuard::canSubmit per REQ-BCF-003), accept (submitted→accepted, external actor), settle (accepted→settled, webhook-triggered per REQ-BCF-007). BcfClaimGuard::canSubmit recomputes the compensable total server-side and verifies the claim quarter is closed (FiscalPeriod lookup) — fail-closed on any exception (CWE-863).

BbvAccountMapping fragment extends the schema (declared in sibling add-shillinq-bookkeeping-operations) with: bcfCompensable (boolean, default false) and compensablePercentage (integer 0-100, default 100). Both fields non-breaking and additive per REQ-BCF-004.

Declarative aggregation shape documented on BcfClaim: source=GLLine, scope={administrationId, claimQuarter→periodId}, filter={GLLine.side=debit, eliminationFlag=false, BbvAccountMapping.bcfCompensable=true}, join through BbvAccountMapping selecting compensablePercentage, weight = compensablePercentage/100, targets totalCompensableAmount=sum + breakdown=rows. Engine-side fallback in PHP (real ObjectService API findAll) lives in BcfClaimService (computeClaim, compensableAmountsByAccount, mappingsByAccount) + BcfCompensationCalculator (integer-cent computeCompensation, canSubmit precondition). Tested via 25 BCF tests + 109 assertions (BcfClaimServiceTest + BcfClaimFragmentTest + BcfCompensationCalculatorTest + BcfClaimGuardTest) — all green.

OR ScheduledWorkflow registered: slug shillinq-bcf-quarterly-digikoppeling-submission, engine=openconnector, workflowId=digikoppeling-bcf, intervalSec=7776000 (90 days / quarterly), enabled=true, payload targets BcfClaim for gemeente/provincie/waterschap administrations. Per ADR-019 the OpenConnector source is registered separately (cross-app).

accepted → settled transition declares no local guard and is documented as triggered by the OpenConnector digikoppeling-bcf settlement webhook (REQ-BCF-007); manual fallback when the webhook is lost. No app-local glue — OR's generic webhook handler routes the event to the lifecycle transition.

Repair step (lib/Repair/InitializeSettings.php; the original task referenced lib/Migration/ but shillinq uses Repair per ADR / repair-steps in info.xml) extended with registerBcfQuarterlyDigikoppelingWorkflow() following the same idempotent pattern as registerIv3ScheduledWorkflow and registerFixedAssetsMonthlyDepreciationWorkflow — slug-based dedup, silent skip when ScheduledWorkflowMapper is unavailable. Existing repair-steps wiring in appinfo/info.xml runs InitializeSettings.

Visibility-predicate scoped to municipal administrations per REQ-BCF-001. i18n: 8 nl/en keys present (BCF-claim, BCF-claims, Btw-compensatiefonds, Compensabele BTW, Compensabel percentage, Ingediend, Geaccepteerd, Afgewikkeld).

ADR-000 data-model gained the BcfClaim entity entry (Schema.org MonetaryAmount, Primary spec bookkeeping-bcf-vat-compensation, 11 properties, relations to Administration / BbvAccountMapping / GLLine, declarative x-openregister-lifecycle, ScheduledWorkflow submission via OpenConnector digikoppeling-bcf source, additive BbvAccountMapping fields bcfCompensable + compensablePercentage).
